notes.title: Developement update
notes.notes:
Just a quick update on the state of the game following the new year.

Half of ACT 1 is now complete!
This may not seem like much out of the 3 acts, as it only means 1/6th of the content is finished, but this is a good milestone because this is the point where the game shifts slowly into a more open experience and some of the key reveals in the story occur.

You might have noticed that the game dropped the Early Access label. This is due to me planning to no longer use the system.
This obviously means the release date is moved to "when its done". 
The closest possible release would be in about 2 years from now. :(

I had and is still considering weather or not to do a crowdfunding campaign of some form for the game, not so much to finish it but to give it extra umpf via more music, more voice-acting, etc.

Anyway here is an updated roadmap for the game.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kfFL3q1.jpeg[/img]

notes.title: Developement update
notes.notes:
Chapter 3-4 are fully complete.
Chapter 5 is halfway complete now.

Long and short of it is, I was thinking of releasing the game into Early Access at and around chapter 6 when the halfway point of the first arc of the story is reached.

The full game consists of 3 acts, each act containing 13 chapters. 
The demo is the first 2 chapters only.


So the question is should I wait for even more of act 1 to be completed or release at chapter 6.....
